The generic reading mistake

The same card does not say the same thing to everyone

You can already read any card. The Five of Swords, for example, is conflict: an argument. But in a love reading, the message changes with your moment:

SINGLEGames and pride when you are trying to win someone over.
IN A RELATIONSHIPThe fight where you both lose.
GETTING OVER ONEThe last argument, the one that still hurts.

Reading the card the same way for anyone is what makes so many love readings vague, or scary for no reason. The fix is the Love Lens: the meaning of the card, with your situation on top.
